result.note: Tested the venue of the 26th SCO summit, a durable summit-and-venue fact; the Tashkent leg serves as a distractor.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi was scheduled to attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit on 31 August and 1 September 2026. In which city was this summit to be held?
questions.explain: The 26th SCO summit was set for Bishkek, capital of the Kyrgyz Republic. Tashkent was the earlier leg of the trip, a state visit on 29-30 August for talks with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on trade, defence, critical minerals and energy.
questions.source: then flies to Bishkek for the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit on August 31 and September 1.
